arguments.summary: Triage complete. Both proposed cross-role questions were material and resolvable from completed specialist work, so each was approved with reuse of the corresponding completed task; no new research was routed.
assumptions: This triage disposition is procedural and does not itself make a directional NVDA-versus-MU assessment.
Completed Company and Macro findings remain subject to their stated evidence and valuation/policy qualifications.
arguments.counter_thesis: Neither reused answer should be treated as proof of causality: Company evidence only refines conditional earnings transmission, and Macro evidence only establishes a mixed cross-asset backdrop rather than broad risk-on confirmation.

question_effects.reason: Approved using task-3: the Company findings distinguish NVDA’s accelerated-computing demand/margin bridge from MU’s AI-memory pricing, supply and margin-durability bridge, refining Macro’s conditional transmission paths.

Approved using task-4: the Macro findings characterize supplied cross-asset observations as mixed, so Technical leadership remains stock-specific and cannot be presented as causal broad risk-on confirmation.

agent_report.work_summary: Reviewed both proposed questions, their stated decision impact, the completed role-task status, and the available completed Company and Macro findings. Confirmed that each question could be answered without new work and recorded reuse of task-3 and task-4, respectively.
main_conclusions: The Macro-to-Company question was material and answered by the completed Company work.
The Technical-to-Macro confirmation question was material and answered by the completed Macro work.
No additional question warranted routing or use of final-synthesis capacity.
agent_report.short_summary: Both proposed follow-ups were approved and resolved by existing specialist analyses. Triage adds no independent directional stock view.
limitations: This stage did not independently recalculate valuation, price behavior, policy exposure, or operating results.
Final synthesis must still reconcile the specialist qualifications and Challenger risk view.
